description: Should this outing go ahead? Returns GO, CAUTION or NO-GO with reasons, from the National Weather Service forecast and active alerts, live USGS river gauges (flow and 6-hour trend) for paddling, rafting, fishing and swimming, NOAA tide times on the coast, and sun and moon times. Works in launch metros or anywhere in the US with latitude and longitude.

date.description: "today", "tomorrow", a weekday, "this weekend" or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the coming Saturday. Forecasts reach about 7 days.

latitude.description: Latitude of the exact spot (trailhead, put-in, lake). Use with longitude for anywhere in the US.

metro.description: Launch metro or nearby city, e.g. "Johnson City", "Knoxville", "Denver".

place_name.description: Optional label for the spot, e.g. "Watauga River put-in".

name: conditions_check
title: Conditions Check (Go / No-Go)
